dct_description_sm: The 1990-1991 data were collected to measure body condition of cows in all lactation classes, a response to concerns of local hunters, who noticed that harvested caribou were in very poor condition during the fall of 1990. The collections between 1992 and 1995 were designed to look at the relationship between growth and condition of cow/calf pairs in an effort to evaluate maternal investment in the Porcupine herd.
dct_title_s: Body condition data for the Porcupine caribou herd, 1990-1995 -Russell data
